text: pariññeyyā . [292] katame ca bhikkhave dhammā abhiññā pahātabbā . avijjā ca bhavataṇhā ca . ime bhikkhave dhammā abhiññā pahātabbā . [293] katame ca bhikkhave dhammā abhiññā sacchikātabbā . vijjā ca vimutti ca . ime bhikkhave dhammā abhiññā sacchikātabbā . [294] katame ca bhikkhave dhammā abhiññā bhāvetabbā . samatho ca vipassanā ca . ime bhikkhave dhammā abhiññā bhāvetabbā . [295] kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto ye
